column1: # SDR FPGA block map for tools/sdr_progress.py (T23 "SDR progress"). Columns and seed syntax: see the tool's docstring.
# Rows are in priority order: a cell belongs to the first block that reaches it, so the RTL-verified blocks come first
# (their cell sets are the exact slices the RTL was checked against), then the specific blocks, then the broad ones.
# Seeds are cell/site names from docs/code/sdr/netlist.md (which cites them); no netlist data is stored here.
